name: GMX V1 EVM
rootCause: GMX V1 Perps on Arbitrum was exploited on 18 September 2022, resulting in a loss of approximately $565,000. A trader used stale price arbitrage by manipulating reference prices and extracting profits from liquidity providers. GMX V1 Perps relied on spot oracle prices without charging price impact for large perpetual trades, making it susceptible to price manipulation via external venues. This enabled a trader to profit from stale price arbitrage at the expense of liquidity providers.
